title: John Summit & David Guetta Dominate WARM Global Dance Radio Chart With Multiple Hits
summary: The chart ranks the top dance tracks worldwide, based on monitored airplay across 200-plus dance stations in more than 30 countries.
contentText:
John Summit and David Guetta continue to impact the WARM Global Dance Radio chart , as each artist places four songs on the latest ranking (dated May 9), the most of any acts this week.

Summit appears with “All the Time,” with the Chainsmokers and Ilsey (holding at its No. 13 high); “Shades of Blue,” with Devault and Julia Church (up 42-25); “Shadows,” with LAVINIA (down 30-39, after reaching No. 8); and “Chica 305,” with Feid (68-70).

Guetta, meanwhile, charts with “Save Me Tonight,” with Jennifer Lopez (up 8-7); “Awake,” with Afrojack and Sia (34-17); “Upside Down (Extended Mix),” with Jaden Bojsen (25-40); and “Crazy” (released under his Jack Back alias), with Matt Sassari featuring Amira Eldine (69-54).

Since Billboard began publishing the chart in March in partnership with World Airplay Radio Monitor, Summit leads all artists with seven total entries, following by Guetta with five.

At the top of the chart, ANOTR’s “Talk to You,” featuring 54 Ultra, logs a fifth total and consecutive week at No. 1 powered by nearly 1,000 plays (up 2% week over week) across 200-plus monitored stations worldwide April 24-30, according to WARM. Bebe Rexha and Faithless’ “New Religion” holds at its No. 2 high (up 10% in plays), Calvin Harris and Kasabian’s former four-week leader “Release the Pressure” is steady at No. 3, Prospa and Cloonee’s “Free Your Mind” rises 6-4 for a new best and Milky X Mall Grab’s “Just the Way You Are” falls 4-5.

Elsewhere, The Bausa’s “Magnetic” surges 14-10 (up 9%), marking the Norwegian trio’s first top 10 on the chart.

Further down, James Hurr and Wh0’s “Out the Door” is the top debut at No. 77, earning each act its first appearance on the ranking.

The WARM Global Dance Radio chart debuted on Billboard.com in March, joining Billboard’s long-standing U.S.-based dance lists, including Hot Dance/Electronic Songs, Hot Dance/Pop Songs, Dance/Mix Show Airplay and Top Dance Albums. The 40-position Global Dance Radio chart (published in full as a 100-position ranking on WARM’s platform) aggregates plays from 200-plus dance-dedicated radio stations across more than 30 countries, reflecting songs trending globally through a network of programmers and radio gatekeepers operating across multiple territories.

Check out the top 40 of the WARM Global Dance Radio chart on Billboard.com and head over to WARM’s website for the full 100-position survey.
